Enugu Governor Peter Mbah appointed Destiny Etiko as Senior Special Assistant on youth engagement and the creative economy.
Congratulating Destiny Etiko in an Instagram post, actress Sarah Martins wrote, “Congratulations, my boo. Appointment well deserved.
Confirming the news, Destiny Etiko wrote, “My love, I appreciate you.”
Other actors, including Ikpechukwu Nweke and Evan Okoro, also made posts to congratulate the actress.
